articles.title: Power Cut Kills Young Man During Dialysis in UP Hospital – Mother Pleads for Justice!
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Bijnor, UP: A 26-year-old man, Sarfaraz, tragically lost his life during dialysis at a government hospital in Bijnor due to a sudden power outage. The hospital's generator failed to start—reportedly because there was no diesel.

body.html:
Bijnor, UP: A 26-year-old man, Sarfaraz, tragically lost his life during dialysis at a government hospital in Bijnor due to a sudden power outage. The hospital's generator failed to start—reportedly because there was no diesel.

His mother, Salma, in a heart-wrenching statement, said, “My son's blood was stuck in the machine… I kept screaming to start the generator, but no one helped.”

The incident occurred while Chief Development Officer Purna Bora was inspecting the hospital. The District Magistrate has ordered an inquiry, and the grieving family has now appealed to UP Deputy CM Brajesh Pathak for strict action.

This shocking case has raised serious questions about hospital negligence and emergency preparedness in government institutions.

articles.title: Blast Horror in Agra's Kinari Bazar: Silver Factory Explosion Kills 2, Injures 4
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Agra: A massive explosion rocked a silver smelting factory in the congested Kinari Bazar area of Kotwali on Tuesday afternoon, leaving 2 dead and 4 seriously injured. The intensity of the blast shattered glass panes of nearby shops and showrooms, sparking panic across the busy market.

body.html:
Agra: A massive explosion rocked a silver smelting factory in the congested Kinari Bazar area of Kotwali on Tuesday afternoon, leaving 2 dead and 4 seriously injured. The intensity of the blast shattered glass panes of nearby shops and showrooms, sparking panic across the busy market.

Eyewitnesses described scenes of chaos and terror — flames and smoke engulfed the area as people ran for safety. Several passersby were injured by broken glass, and one youth fell off his scooter in panic. Businesses shut down within minutes, with many fearing it was an earthquake.

CCTV footage shows the terrifying moment when the explosion occurred, injuring pedestrians and riders. In one video, two youths are seen engulfed in flames before fleeing the scene.

Rahul Gupta of RS Jewellers, located nearby, was caught in the blast moments after stepping outside. His hair and clothes caught fire, and he had to douse himself with water. “I thought I wouldn’t survive,” he recalled.

Emergency teams, including DCP City Sonam Kumar, ADCP Aditya Singh, and other senior officers, reached the site swiftly. Barricades were put up at the Fountain Crossing and rescue operations began as officials urged the crowd to clear the area via public announcements.

The cause of the explosion is under investigation.

articles.title: Brutal Betrayal on Meerut Footpath: Woman Murdered by Live-in Lover After Suspecting 'Wrong Company'
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Meerut: Moni, who had left her family in Muzaffarnagar and was living on the streets of Meerut with her 6-year-old daughter, was brutally murdered by her live-in partner Kartar, a rickshaw driver.

body.html:
Meerut: Moni, who had left her family in Muzaffarnagar and was living on the streets of Meerut with her 6-year-old daughter, was brutally murdered by her live-in partner Kartar, a rickshaw driver.

Police said Kartar, who lived with Moni for the past 4 months, suspected her of associating with a woman involved in prostitution. On June 12, he took Moni to a deserted building in the Cantt area, where he had sex with her and then crushed her to death with bricks.

After the murder, Kartar left Moni’s daughter at his rickshaw owner’s house and fled. He has since been arrested by the police.

articles.title: ‘Moral Policing’ Turns Deadly: Kamal Kaur Bhabhi Strangled to Death – 2 Held, Mastermind Still

articles.excerpt: Bathinda: Social media influencer Kanchan Kumari alias Kamal Kaur Bhabhi (30) was brutally murdered on 9 June in the parking lot of a hospital in Bathinda, Punjab. Jaspreet Singh and Nimratjit Singh have been arrested, while the main conspirator, Amritpal, is absconding.

body.html:
Bathinda: Social media influencer Kanchan Kumari alias Kamal Kaur Bhabhi (30) was brutally murdered on 9 June in the parking lot of a hospital in Bathinda, Punjab.

Jaspreet Singh and Nimratjit Singh have been arrested, while the main conspirator, Amritpal, is absconding. Police say Amritpal lured her from Ludhiana under the pretext of a business meeting. She was strangled in her car with a waistband.

Shocking details reveal that the murder was driven by "moral policing." The accused claimed Kanchan’s social media content was “immoral” and hurt religious sentiments — prompting them to take this extreme step.
